yaml.subtitle: La experiencia de Costa Rica, en diálogo con El Salvador
yaml.author: Superintendencia de Pensiones (SUPEN), Costa Rica

include-in-header.text:
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Literata:opsz,wght@7..72,500;7..72,700&family=Public+Sans:wght@400;600;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --r-main-font-size:27px;
    --azul:#12355b; --cielo:#4a90c8; --rojo:#c8102e;
    --verde:#2a9d8f; --ambar:#e9a23b; --papel:#f7f9fb; --tinta:#1d2733;
  }
  .reveal{font-family:"Public Sans",system-ui,sans-serif; color:var(--tinta);}
  .reveal .slides{text-align:left;}
  .reveal h1,.reveal h2,.reveal h3{font-family:"Literata",Georgia,serif; color:var(--azul); text-transform:none; letter-spacing:-.01em;}
  .reveal h2{font-size:1.55em; border-left:10px solid var(--cielo); padding-left:.45em;}
  .reveal .slide-background.title-bg,.reveal section.title-bg{}
  .reveal .footer{font-size:.42em; color:#5b6b7c;}
  .reveal .progress{color:var(--rojo);}
  .reveal .title-slide h1.title{font-size:1.9em; line-height:1.15;}
  .reveal .title-slide .subtitle{color:var(--cielo); font-family:"Public Sans";}
  .franja{height:10px; background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--azul) 0 33%, #fff 33% 40%, var(--rojo) 40% 60%, #fff 60% 67%, var(--cielo) 67% 100%); border-radius:5px; margin:.4em 0 .8em;}
  .tarjeta{background:var(--papel); border-left:6px solid var(--cielo); padding:.5em .75em; border-radius:6px; margin:.3em 0; font-size:.92em;}
  .tarjeta.riesgo{border-left-color:var(--rojo);}
  .tarjeta.control{border-left-color:var(--verde);}
  .tarjeta.pension{border-left-color:var(--ambar); background:#fff8ec;}
  .sabia{background:var(--azul); color:#fff; padding:.7em 1em; border-radius:10px; font-size:.8em;}
  .sabia b{color:var(--ambar);}
  .pregunta{font-family:"Literata",serif; font-size:1.5em; color:var(--azul); line-height:1.25; margin-top:1.2em;}
  .cifra{font-family:"Literata",serif; font-size:2.6em; color:var(--rojo); font-weight:700; line-height:1;}
  .pie{font-size:.5em; color:#5b6b7c;}
  .kpis{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:.5em; margin-top:.4em;}
  .kpi{background:var(--papel); border-radius:8px; padding:.45em .6em; border-top:5px solid var(--azul);}
  .kpi .v{font-family:"Literata",serif; font-size:1.25em; font-weight:700; color:var(--azul);}
  .kpi .e{font-size:.6em; color:#4a5a6a;}
  .fb{padding:.5em .8em; border-radius:8px; font-size:.85em; margin-top:.4em;}
  .fb.ok{background:#e3f4f1; border-left:6px solid var(--verde);}
  .fb.bad{background:#fde8eb; border-left:6px solid var(--rojo);}
  .fb.neutro{background:var(--papel); border-left:6px solid #9aa8b6;}
  .mensaje{background:#fff; border:1px solid #cfd8e2; border-radius:12px; padding:.6em .9em; font-size:.72em; box-shadow:0 2px 0 #cfd8e2;}
  .barra{height:26px; background:#e5ebf1; border-radius:13px; overflow:hidden;}
  .barra > div{height:100%; border-radius:13px; transition:width .4s;}
  .reveal form{font: 19px/1.35 "Public Sans",system-ui,sans-serif !important; --label-width:170px;} .reveal form input[type=number]{width:6.2em !important; max-width:none !important; flex-shrink:0;}
  .reveal .observablehq{font-size:.9em;}
  .reveal section.seccion h1{color:#fff; font-size:2.2em;}
  .reveal section.seccion p{color:#d6e4f2;}
  .flujo{display:flex; gap:16px; margin:.5em 0;}
  .flujo .paso{flex:1; background:var(--papel); border-radius:10px; padding:.7em .75em; font-size:.98em; position:relative; border-top:5px solid var(--cielo);}
  .flujo .paso.ia{border-top-color:var(--rojo); background:#fff4f5;}
  .flujo .paso .ico{display:block; font-size:2em; line-height:1.25;}
  .flujo .paso small{display:block; color:#4a5a6a; font-size:.85em; margin-top:.2em;}
  .flujo .paso:not(:last-child)::after{content:"→"; position:absolute; right:-14px; top:38%; color:var(--rojo); font-weight:700;}
  .reveal table{font-size:.66em; border-collapse:collapse;}
  .reveal table th{background:var(--azul); color:#fff; padding:.4em .6em;}
  .reveal table td{padding:.4em .6em; border-bottom:1px solid #dfe6ee;}
  .frase{font-family:"Literata",serif; font-size:1.7em; line-height:1.2; color:var(--azul); font-weight:700;}
  .tablero{width:100%; font-size:.8em;}
  .tablero .fila{display:grid; grid-template-columns:2.2fr 2fr .9fr .3fr; gap:.6em; align-items:center; padding:.35em 0; border-bottom:1px solid #e3e9ef;}
  .tablero .sem{width:18px; height:18px; border-radius:50%;}
  .reveal section.cierre h2{color:#fff; border-left-color:var(--rojo);}
  .reveal section.cierre .frase{margin:.8em 0 .3em;}
  .reveal form label{font-size:19px !important;}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ .barra > div{transition:none;} }
</style>
